answer: Give every account a numbered violet bed in a shared community garden beside the old grove, grown from a single seed packet issued once per person. Each month the owner tends the bed in person, logging the violets' bloom stage, while two neighboring gardeners sign the entry after inspecting the plot themselves. A Sybil farm would need a separate living bed, regular hands-on care, and different witnesses for every identity, so faking hundreds of accounts means maintaining hundreds of real violet beds under real neighbors' eyes, and any bed left untended soon withers and exposes the fraud.
